ORDER BY s.issue_key;

WITH t AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2014-03-19 21:05' AS t1, TIMESTAMP '2014-06-01 15:58' AS t2),
base AS (
  SELECT fv.issue_key, fv.value, fv.valid_from, fv.valid_to, fv.recorded_at, fv.superseded_at
  FROM field_versions fv JOIN issues i ON i.key = fv.issue_key
  WHERE i.project = 'TAJO' AND fv.field = 'status' AND fv.value IN ('In Progress','Patch Available')
)
SELECT b.issue_key,
  MAX(CASE WHEN b.valid_from <= t.t1 AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_to > t.t1) AND b.recorded_at <= t.t2 AND (b.superseded_at IS NULL OR b.superseded_at > t.t2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS at_t1,
  MAX(CASE WHEN b.valid_from <= t.t2 AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_to > t.t2) AND b.recorded_at <= t.t2 AND (b.superseded_at IS NULL OR b.superseded_at > t.t2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS at_t2
FROM base b CROSS JOIN t
GROUP BY b.issue_key
HAVING at_t1 = 1 AND at_t2 = 1
ORDER BY b.issue_key
